source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ethelbert βασιλιάς της Αγγλίας»

attestations.note: The day's line calls him king of England and the body corrects that to Kent: «Αγγλοσάξονας βασιλεύς του Κεντ με έδρα το Καντέρμπουρυ», an Anglo-Saxon king of Kent with his seat at Canterbury. The page heads him «(; - 616)», names his wife Bertha, a Christian out of France, and the monk Augustine at the head of the missionaries out of Rome, and lists the churches he founded.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ethelbert κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 616 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 616)», leaving the year of his birth a question mark.
